task.question: What was the best exact-match performance on the sentencing tasks of the TAM benchmark?
task.evidence: We evaluate general-purpose prompting approaches, including retrieval-augmented generation, ReAct-style prompting, and an agent-harness baseline on GPT-5, and find that the best exact-match performance remains extremely low: 1% on ICD-10-CM coding and 15.5% on sentencing tasks.

answer:
The best exact-match performance on the sentencing tasks of the TAM (Textual Analogy and Metaphor) benchmark was 43.1%.  

FINAL: 43.1%
